secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret API key (Stripe dashboard -> Developers -> API keys). Needed for premium subscription checkout.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable API key (Stripe dashboard -> Developers -> API keys). Needed for premium subscription checkout in the browser.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for the /api/webhooks/stripe endpoint (Stripe dashboard -> Developers -> Webhooks).

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_MONTHLY_PRICE_ID
secrets.description: Stripe price ID for the $9.99/month plan (scripts/setup-stripe-prices.ts prints it).

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_YEARLY_PRICE_ID
secrets.description: Stripe price ID for the $99.99/year plan (scripts/setup-stripe-prices.ts prints it).

secrets.name: MUX_TOKEN_ID
secrets.description: Mux API access token ID (Mux dashboard -> Settings -> Access Tokens). Needed for video upload and playback.

secrets.name: MUX_TOKEN_SECRET
secrets.description: Mux API access token secret (Mux dashboard -> Settings -> Access Tokens). Needed for video upload and playback.

secrets.name: MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Mux webhook signing secret for the /api/webhooks/mux endpoint (Mux dashboard -> Settings -> Webhooks).

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MUX_ENV_KEY
secrets.description: Mux environment key used by the Mux player (Mux dashboard -> Settings -> Environment Keys).
